scenario:
An agricultural economics research institute is developing a comprehensive decision support system for optimizing farm resource management and maximizing profitability. The system is designed to assist farmers and agricultural planners in evaluating different farming strategies, considering factors like irrigation, land leasing, crop production, and revenue optimization. The platform will provide in-depth analysis of production data, financial outcomes of different land use scenarios, and the impact of various strategies on farm profitability.

The system will allow users to model and simulate different agricultural scenarios, comparing the effects of crop selection, fallow periods, and irrigation strategies on overall farm economics. It will also evaluate the financial implications of leasing decisions and alternative farming practices. The platform must support detailed reporting and analytics, enabling users to assess revenue potential and forecast production outcomes under varying conditions.

Additionally, the system will include a robust user account management feature to control access based on roles such as farmers, economists, and policy makers. Advanced data visualization tools will help stakeholders make informed decisions regarding resource allocation, sustainability, and economic viability in agriculture.
